---
applyTo: 'packages/v2/**/*.{ts,tsx}'
---

# v2 code conventions

This file owns the code conventions for `packages/v2/`. Workflows and patterns are in skills; start with `.github/skills/v2-architecture/SKILL.md`, which lists which skill owns what.

## Imports

- Use the `.js` suffix in import paths, never `.ts` or no suffix
- Import directly from the file, not from barrel `index.ts` files or `@k9-sak-web/backend`
- Never import from non-v2 packages (`@k9-sak-web/utils`, `@k9-sak-web/types`, `@k9-sak-web/shared-components`, etc.)

## Type safety

v2 uses the strictest TypeScript config. Never use `any`, type assertions (`as`) or non-null assertions (`!`), and use `import type` for type-only imports. How to handle types instead is described in the `typescript` skill.

## CSS modules

Use dot notation: `styles.myClass`, never `styles['myClass']`. Each `*.module.css` has a generated `*.module.css.d.ts`; generate it if it is missing.

## Design decisions

UI decisions that apply across panels are in the `design-*` skills in `.github/skills/` (for example `design-alerts`). Follow them in new code and in code you change anyway. Do not rewrite existing components only to follow them.

## Text

v2 has no i18n. Write Norwegian strings directly.
